content: RAG systems perform optimally with chunk sizes between 500-1000 tokens for semantic search accuracy. Larger chunks preserve context but reduce precision.
When selecting LLMs for code generation, Claude 3.5 Sonnet excels at understanding complex contexts while GPT-4 Turbo is superior for edge case handling.
Docker builds for Next.js should use standalone output mode for 3x smaller images. Always build with --platform linux/amd64 for AWS EC2 compatibility.
SSM deployment via GitHub Actions is more reliable than SSH. Use instance profiles with minimal IAM permissions for security.
Users prefer progressive disclosure - show essential info first, details on demand. Wizard flows increase completion rates by 40% over single-page forms.
Collapsible sidebars need clear tooltips on hover. Users feel lost without navigation labels - always provide context in collapsed state.
Freemium with 3-tier pricing converts 5-8% of free users. Target $19-49 sweet spot for B2B SaaS. Rule of Acquisition #1: Once you have their money, never give it back.
Development-phase CI/CD costs can exceed $50/month. Manual milestone pushes during active development save 40% on infrastructure costs.
Always validate auth tokens server-side. Never trust client-side validation for security. Defense in depth is not optional.
AWS IAM policies should follow least-privilege principle. Deployer users need only specific permissions - never use AdministratorAccess.
When SSM commands fail, check instance profile and IAM roles first - 90% of issues are permissions. Always verify the instance is running and SSM agent is active.
Turbopack has issues with helper components defined after main exports. Always define helper components before the main export function.
Start with one excellent feature rather than many mediocre ones. Quality begets trust. A ship is only as strong as its foundation.
Cross-functional teams outperform siloed experts. Pair mentors with generalists for knowledge transfer. The whole is greater than the sum of its parts.
Parallel work on similar domains across projects multiplies learning. When Data works on AI for one project, those insights accelerate all AI work.
System health checks should run at multiple levels: unit, integration, and end-to-end. Early detection prevents cascading failures.
API error messages should be actionable. Tell the user what went wrong AND how to fix it. Good communication prevents support tickets.

MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers enable AI agents to be IDE-independent. The @modelcontextprotocol/sdk package provides Server, StdioServerTransport for stdio-based communication with tools and prompts capabilities.

OpenRouter API (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions) provides unified access to multiple LLMs. Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY header. Response format follows OpenAI structure with choices[0].message.content.
MCP server in Cursor requires ~/.cursor/mcp.json config with command, args, and env. Environment variables can use ${VAR} syntax for passthrough from shell. Restart Cursor after config changes.

Alex AI independence achieved through MCP server with OpenRouter integration. Each crew member now has their own LLM assignment - Claude for strategic/empathetic roles, GPT-4 for analytical/thorough tasks. The crew is no longer bound to any single AI provider.

Session completed: Created Alex AI MCP server (mcp-server/index.mjs) with 7 tools - alex_ai_chat, alex_ai_coordinate, alex_ai_memories, alex_ai_save_memory, alex_ai_projects, alex_ai_milestone, alex_ai_observation_lounge. Server v2.0 uses OpenRouter for independent LLM responses.

Crew LLM assignments: Picard/Riker/Geordi/Troi use anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet (strategic, coordination, engineering, empathy). Data/Worf/O'Brien/Quark use openai/gpt-4-turbo (analysis, security, implementation, business). Each has custom temperature settings.

The Observation Lounge tool creates multi-agent discussions where crew members respond sequentially, each building on previous perspectives. This models real collaborative decision-making and provides diverse viewpoints on complex topics.
